Definition: A control that fills up from left to right to show how much of a task is done.
The number that says how full the progress bar is right now.
The value that means the task has not started. The bar is empty at this value. It is 0 unless you change it.
The value that means the task is finished. The bar is full at this value. It is 100 unless you change it.
An action Quorum calls many times every second while a program runs, so the program can change things over time.
